subject: MAP template + kickoff doc for NovaHealth evaluation
messages:
From: Anna Lee <anna.lee@novahealth.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: MAP template + kickoff gdoc for NovaHealth eval

Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday. Leadership is aligned enough that we want to put together a concrete evaluation plan and milestone slate (MAP) to get a 30–45 day pilot underway. Can you share your recommended MAP template and a starter Google Doc / slides stub we can co-edit?

Goals for the MAP:
- 30-day technical validation (latency & accuracy on our dataset)
- Stakeholder signoffs for security & privacy (we'll need SOC 2 details in the plan)
- Acceptance criteria for performance and cost targets

We'd appreciate a simple week-by-week milestone grid and a short slide deck (2–3 slides) we can use for an internal kickoff.

People on our side who will be involved: David Chen (engineering lead) and myself.

Preferred times for a short MAP-kickoff co-edit session: Friday 8/7 after 2pm PT or Monday 8/10 between 10–12 PT.

Appreciate it —
Anna
Anna Lee
Head of Partnerships, NovaHealth
anna.lee@novahealth.io
+1 415-555-0142

——

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@novahealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-07T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: MAP template + kickoff gdoc for NovaHealth eval

Anna —

Great to hear. I pushed a lightweight MAP starter doc and a 2-slide kickoff stub to Google Drive for co-authoring: links below. I've also attached a PDF export of the template for quick offline review.

Quick summary of what's in the MAP starter:
- Week 0: access, safe test dataset ingest, baseline run (owner: NovaHealth eng)
- Week 1: perf & correctness runs, KV/prefix caching setup (owner: NovaHealth + Redwood infra)
- Week 2: tuning (batching/quantization suggestions) & regression checks (owner: Redwood R&D)
- Week 3: acceptance runs and economics review (owners: NovaHealth product + Redwood CS)
- Deliverables & acceptance criteria page with pass/fail metrics (latency P50/P95, task accuracy, token cost)

Attachments (stubs):
- MAP_template_v1.pdf (brief; printable)
- MAP_kickoff_gslides_stub.pptx (2 slides: scope + timeline)

Google links (edit access):
- MAP starter doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFG-map-prototype
- Kickoff slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/2xYz-MapSlides-stub

Action items I recommend now:
1) David / engineering to drop in their baseline dataset notes under "Week 0" in the doc.
2) Anna to confirm preferred kickoff time — we can do Friday 8/7 at 3pm PT (today) if that still works; otherwise Monday 8/10 10:30am PT.
3) Marissa will draft a short runbook for getting keys and test tokens into NovaHealth's staging account.

Marissa & Jasmine — copying you to track the doc and to add the runbook + slides notes.

I'll hold a short co-edit session if you want — happy to jump on whichever slot you pick.

Best,
Rishi
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

——

From: Anna Lee <anna.lee@novahealth.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Chen <david.chen@novahealth.io>
Date: 2026-08-07T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: MAP template + kickoff gdoc for NovaHealth eval

Rishi —

Thanks for the quick turn. I just gave David and myself comment access to the doc (we used your links). Friday 3pm PT works for us — please send a calendar invite and we'll join.

Notes we added in comments:
- We'll include a short SOC 2 checklist under the "security" deliverable; our compliance lead may ask for a Redwood contact for evidence requests.
- For baseline runs: David will paste a small sample dataset and notes by EOD Friday.

One ask: can you add a short row in the MAP for "risk & mitigation" (2–3 bullets) — e.g., model drift handling, fallback model option? That'll help our product and security teams sign off faster.

Appreciate the runbook offer — if Marissa can include the minimal steps for key exchange and a short troubleshooting list in the doc before the call, that'll speed things up.

See you at 3pm PT.
Anna

——

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@novahealth.io>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: MAP template + kickoff gdoc for NovaHealth eval — updated slides + runbook

Hi Anna / team —

Following our call today, I've uploaded an updated slides stub and a brief runbook into the MAP doc. Changes at a glance:
- Slides: added an acceptance-metrics slide (P50/P95 latency, sample task accuracy, cost per 1k tokens) and a roles & owners slide.
- Runbook: step-by-step to obtain staging tokens, add test endpoints, and quick troubleshooting steps for common ingestion errors.
- Risk & mitigation row added per your request (drift detection, automatic fallback to smaller model, throttling policy).

Attachments included: MAP_kickoff_gslides_stub.pptx (updated) — and a one-page PDF export for your compliance folder.

Next actions (owners):
- David: paste baseline sample dataset into Week 0 section (owner: NovaHealth) — due EOD Monday 8/10.
- Rishi: confirm final acceptance thresholds once David's baseline is in.
- Jasmine: schedule a 30-min checkpoint for Week 2 tuning run (tentatively 8/24).

If anyone needs edit rights changed or a separate compliance package (SOC2 evidence pointer), ping me and I'll loop in our security lead.

Thanks — looking forward to a fast pilot.
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAP_kickoff_gslides_stub.pptx, MAP_template_v1.pdf
